adjudication.rationale: The diff shows a findFirst followed by conditional create pattern in app-credential.ts (lines 57-88). If two concurrent webhook requests arrive for the same userId and appSlug, both could execute findFirst before either creates a credential, resulting in both finding null and both creating duplicate credentials. This is a classic race condition - the code lacks any transaction or unique constraint enforcement visible in the diff.
